mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A drop in the unemployment rate below 7.0% triggers a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it signals labor market recovery and increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite UNRATE crossing below 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in consumer demand (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) predicts positive 5-day S&P 500 returns as both signals robust economic momentum.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not positive despite both proxies rising.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained drop in the federal funds rate below 1.5% signals accommodative policy, boosting equity valuations and driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not positive despite FEDFUNDS below 1.5% in the regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the INDPRO index reflects expanding business capacity, which compresses supply-side bottlenecks and drives positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not positive despite INDPRO rising.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the next 5 days predicts positive S&P 500 returns as it signals labor market strengthening and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not positive despite UNRATE declining.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in both consumer spending (GDPC1) and business investment (RSAFS) simultaneously predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as it indicates robust demand-investment synergy.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive despite both proxies rising.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes, a drop in the unemployment rate below 7.5% triggers positive 60-day S&P 500 returns as it signals labor market recovery and economic revitalization.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not positive despite UNRATE below 7.5% in the regime.
